```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)

vignette_root <- tempfile("hyperion-vignette-")
dir.create(vignette_root, recursive = TRUE)
file.copy(
  list.files(system.file("extdata", package = "hyperion"), full.names = TRUE),
  vignette_root,
  recursive = TRUE
)
file.copy(
  system.file("pharos.toml", package = "hyperion"),
  vignette_root
)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = vignette_root)
```
